title: Thalipeeth
description: Maharashtrian multigrain flatbread made from roasted bhajani flour with onion, chilli and coriander, pressed thin and crisped on a tawa.
steps: Mix 200 g of bhajani with the chopped onion, green chilli, coriander, sesame seeds, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, red chilli powder and salt in a wide bowl.
Add about 150 ml of water a little at a time and knead to a soft, slightly sticky dough that holds together.
Divide the dough into 6 portions and keep a bowl of water nearby for wetting your hands.
Place a portion on a damp cloth or greased plastic sheet and pat it into a thin round, making a small hole in the centre.
Heat a tawa over medium heat, slide the thalipeeth on, and pour a little of the oil into the hole and around the edges.
Cook covered for 2 minutes, flip, and cook until both sides are crisp and speckled brown, then repeat with the remaining portions.
